domain.text: GitHub PR polling reliability and board violation reporting

impressions.text: The delivery addressed false board violations caused by failed pull-request fetches clearing previously collected PR-to-issue links.
The worker reported tests for failed-fetch retention, suppressed violations during failed cycles, and replacement after successful fetches; targeted checks and CI were reported green.
The worker noted other PR-processing side effects remain nontransactional and left full-suite, smoke, and unused-code verification to CI; no unresolved questions or task deviations were reported.
